Usar possessivos (мой/моя/моё/мои) e gên: Use the possessives (мой/моя/моё/мои) and noun gender in practice.
Masculino: consoante (друг, стол). Femin: Every Russian noun has a grammatical gender, and you can usually read it from the last letter. Masculine: a consonant (друг, стол). Feminine: -а / -я (подруга, машина). Neuter: -о / -е (окно, море). English has «he», «she» and «it» only for people and animals; in Russian even a table or a window has a gender. The possessive (my, your…) must match the gender of the noun that follows it.
